input.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers, MIN(signup_date) AS min_signup, MAX(signup_date) AS max_signup, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_iso_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03-%') AS march_iso_rows FROM customers WHERE signup_date NOT GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' OR signup_date IS NULL

final_answer.basis: 語意層無「新註冊客戶」「註冊日期」的對應，改以 customers.signup_date 作為註冊日期，篩選 2025-03-01 至 2025-03-31 並計算不重複 customer_id，結果為 150 位。已檢查 signup_date 全部為 ISO 格式且無空值，且筆數與不重複客戶數一致（皆為 150）。
